snippet.title: Beyond The Mist — Trailer for Steam™ and Nintendo Switch™
snippet.description:
Another day, another... GAME ANNOUNCEMENT! 🥳

M. Webb, the I.S.C. requests your immediate presence. Our previous keeper has vanished without explanation. A replacement is needed at once for the offshore lighthouse under our care. Report to the local office of the company as soon as possible. Do not be late.

Coming to #Steam on Halloween, and #NintendoSwitch on November 19th 🥳

Made by Yliader
🌐Steam: https://rwr.es/s/themist
🌐Nintendo eShop: https://rwr.es/n/themist
